decision.observation: A newly revealed wide green chamber: the ornate snail-shell wheel sits at center on the mossy floor, with a wooden wedge leaning against its lower-left, a black mushroom and Hornet at the right, and a stone wall with shell-fossil columns and hanging moss drapes on the left. Mossy terraces and light shafts fill the background; small mushrooms stand on the terraces. HUD: rosary clock at 0, 2 filled mask pips plus 3 dark rosebuds, needle bar.
decision.hypothesis: This wide room looks distinct from the small wheel pockets, and its left side (stone wall with fossil columns and mossy ledges) may hold a new route. Moving left toward that wall will test it.
decision.memory: New wide green chamber with the central snail-shell wheel; left wall has shell-fossil columns and hanging moss, unexplored.
